notes.title: Perceptions of the Dead 2 - new game release
notes.notes:
Hey all~
Our little indie studio, Ithaqua Labs, just released a new game to Steam!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/817860/Perceptions_of_the_Dead_2/

It's a goofy, spooky story that follows a live-streamer in her search for a ghost hunter.

It features a few familiar voices from the Book of Gray Magic series that you may recognize, as well as lovely music from Johnathan Johnson.

With this game release, we hope to spend some time going back to Brilliant Shadows and Pale Spectrum and doing a bit of maintenance in the coming months, so stay tuned!

notes.title: Ithaqua Labs has a new, free visual novel!
notes.notes:
Hey everybody, we here at Ithaqua Labs have a new, free visual novel that you can play here on Steam.

[h1]Perceptions of the Dead[/h1]
[i]A light horror/comedy story.[/i]
[url=http://store.steampowered.com/app/745760/Perceptions_of_the_Dead/]You can play it for free here![/url]

http://store.steampowered.com/app/745760/Perceptions_of_the_Dead/

[b]The first thing you need to know is that ghosts are real.
The rest, you can only learn on your own.[/b]

Follow three stories set in a world where the dead linger, and things far worse wait beyond the veil.

It has a few voices from the Book of Gray Magic that you guys might recognize!

Since it was met with great approval here on Steam, we've launched a Kickstarter for Part 2 to fund the voice acting for the game.

[h1]Perceptions of the Dead 2 - Kickstarter[/h1]
https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/ithaqualabs/perceptions-of-the-dead-2

We hope you're all having a great new year.
-Ithaqua Labs

notes.title: The Sequel Is Out! Pale Spectrum has been released on Steam!
notes.notes:
Are you ready for more adventures with everyone's favorite band of Ryuusian Mages?

Pale Spectrum has now been released on steam, and for the next week or so will be discounted. Additionally, Brilliant Shadows is severely discounted so you can play the original more cheaply than ever before!

Check out Pale Spectrum here:

http://store.steampowered.com/app/554180/Pale_Spectrum__Part_Two_of_the_Book_of_Gray_Magic/

And we hope you enjoy the new story as much as we enjoyed making it!

notes.title: Brilliant Shadows - 1.3 patch update
notes.notes:
Greetings!
The last patch I did was one year ago tomorrow. Funny, huh?

Updates:
-Music normalized
-Preferences updated
-Textbox and font adjusted for easier reading
-Sprites alignment tweaked, fixed
-Updated a few sprites with new/fixed bug graphics
-Changed the voice actor for two characters, credits adjusted
-A few lines tweaked
-Transitions smoothed, added

notes.title: Brilliant Shadows - Launched!
notes.notes:
Brilliant Shadows is now officially launched!
In the end it sits at 57,023 words, averaging at about 3-5 hours of game play.

All spoken lines are voice acted, and there are 3 different endings based on what choices you pick, as well as a few larger branches within the story itself.
